Delivering unparalleled flexibility, the AVE3 can be used for testing small to large gauge lengths, low to high elongations, flat and round specimens, and sensitive materials like films eliminating the need to purchase and maintain multiple clip-on devices.
The AVE3's compliance to ISO 9513 and ASTM E83, paired with its real-time 500 Hz data rate, allows you to test to the most stringent standards.
